- Interior distances exceed one because tN>1t_N>1tN​>1.
- Interior points remain at radius at most RN−3R_N-3RN​−3; their distances from shell vertices exceed one.
- All distances involving an interior point are strictly below DND_NDN​.
- The full diameter graph remains exactly the longest-chord graph on SNS_NSN​.

Consequently the full unit-contact graph of PNP_NPN​ is exactly the perimeter cycle. There are no unit equilateral triangles.

Positive stress is explicit. Number shell vertices cyclically and put λe=1/N\lambda_e=1/Nλe​=1/N on every longest chord. Put constant weight

μe=cos⁡2(π/(2N))Nsin⁡2(π/N)\mu_e= \frac{\cos^2(\pi/(2N))} {N\sin^2(\pi/N)}μe​=Nsin2(π/N)cos2(π/(2N))​

on every perimeter contact.

The first Fourier mode of the perimeter cycle has Laplacian eigenvalue 4sin⁡2(π/N)4\sin^2(\pi/N)4sin2(π/N), while that of the longest-chord cycle has eigenvalue 4cos⁡2(π/(2N))4\cos^2(\pi/(2N))4cos2(π/(2N)).

LF(μ)PN=LH(λ)PN,∑eλe=1.L_F(\mu)P_N=L_H(\lambda)P_N, \qquad \sum_e\lambda_e=1.LF​(μ)PN​=LH​(λ)PN​,e∑​λe​=1.

### What this countermodel establishes

Linear zzz and η\etaη do not by themselves identify missing packing sites, force a positive-contact interior, or produce a strict same-cardinality diameter improvement.

In this example Source123 has no unloaded positive-contact components. Its exceptional-face charge is therefore empty despite z,η=Θ(D)z,\eta=\Theta(D)z,η=Θ(D).

Scope limitation: This configuration is not certified as a global minimum-diameter packing. Equation (5) still allows an O(D)O(D)O(D) deficit, so it does not refute every possible theorem asserting a positive linear capacity penalty under stronger assumptions, especially global optimality and Type-II fullness.

It refutes the proposed automatic transfer from graph excess to separately chargeable interior vacancies.

## 3. The stronger historical Source123 claim

The [historical augmented-triangle boundary-charge manuscript](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/erdos-99/blob/b05cd57b15252fe99577de3edb0b73070e79544f/research/target_c_section123_augmented_triangle_boundary_charge.md?utm_source=chatgpt.com) additionally claims, conditionally on Type-II near-disk geometry,

The key geometric step is plausible and has a precise mechanism: if an augmented triangular face has unit sides ax,bxax,bxax,bx, then ∣ab∣≤2|ab|\le2∣ab∣≤2. Were ababab to skip a loaded hull vertex yyy, the near-circular short-arc estimate would force both xxx and yyy to approach the midpoint of ababab, contradicting ∣x−y∣≥1|x-y|\ge1∣x−y∣≥1.

Given that short-arc result and interior-disjoint cells, the claimed injection into nonunit hull sides follows. The sharpened algebra also follows from (2).

But the near-disk hypothesis is essential. Neither this historical strengthening nor canonical (4) converts the charged boundary defect into an actual lost population count. The [§122–§123 promotion audit](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/erdos-99/blob/b05cd57b15252fe99577de3edb0b73070e79544f/docs/targets/target-c/122-123-promotion-audit-2026-09-12.md?utm_source=chatgpt.com) explicitly leaves that closure open.

For a global minimizer, the supplied population reserve says, conditionally on the audited reconstruction,

[Population-reserve reconstruction, pinned](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/erdos-99/blob/b05cd57b15252fe99577de3edb0b73070e79544f/docs/reports/population_reserve_independent_reconstruction_2026-10-15.md?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

A capacity proof would need, for every sufficiently large globally minimizing triangle-free source, something like

n≤1+πD223+(1600−ε)D\boxed{ n\le1+\frac{\pi D^2}{2\sqrt3} +\left(\frac1{600}-\varepsilon\right)D }n≤1+23​πD2​+(6001​−ε)D​

with fixed ε>0\varepsilon>0ε>0, or an explicit same-nnn configuration of diameter strictly below DDD.

No audited Source123 charge establishes either statement.

The specific missing lemma must simultaneously connect the selected-core or harmonic-cell excess to an injective loss of global packing capacity, account for all inactive source points and perimeter credits, and work for arbitrary branching cores. It must also cover Type-I macroscopic inactive containers or exclude that regime separately.

Sources59/61 provide genuine linear topological restrictions ([59](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/erdos-99/blob/b05cd57b15252fe99577de3edb0b73070e79544f/docs/targets/target-c/59-difference-body-density-audit.md?utm_source=chatgpt.com), [61](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/erdos-99/blob/b05cd57b15252fe99577de3edb0b73070e79544f/docs/targets/target-c/61-linear-nonmatching-excess-audit.md?utm_source=chatgpt.com)). The known inclusion H(selected)⊆G(original)H(\mathrm{selected})\subseteq G(\mathrm{original})H(selected)⊆G(original) transfers the appropriate nonmatching excess monotonically, but not the selected-core face geometry or a capacity penalty.

Final disposition: Source123's canonical charge passes the independent algebraic and planar-incidence audit, subject to its stated hypotheses. The proposed z,η⟶Ω(D)z,\eta\longrightarrow\Omega(D)z,η⟶Ω(D) additional global packing loss is unproved.
